title: G-Formatter
description:
Text styling made simple. A professional text formatting extension  designed to streamline BBCode insertion and text styling.

Simply Right-Click anywhere in the game to summon the toolbar directly to your cursor, or press Ctrl + Shift + S to open the Settings panel.

Features:
- Right-Click to instantly teleport the menu to your mouse.
- Smart hover submenus for colors, emojis, and clipboard tools.
- Quick toggle for Bold, Underline, and Italic.
- Settings Panel to adjust dynamic idle opacity or pause the extension.
